page_title: MON 2-0 PAU | B. Monchengladbach v St. Pauli 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' Alexander Blessin has decided to make a change. Andreas Nielsen Albers (St. Pauli) replaces Morgan Guilavogui.
90+2' A pass by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+2' Wow, what an escape. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rocco Reitz departs the field of play to be replaced by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' St. Pauli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
89' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from St. Pauli as they win a corner.

88' What a big chance! Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
87' Moritz Nicolas pulls off a good save to deny a long-range header from Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli). Great goalkeeping! St. Pauli have a corner.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from St. Pauli comes to nothing.

85' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play. St. Pauli are awarded a corner kick.

83' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Moritz Nicolas is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Carlo Boukhalfa will be replaced by Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
83' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
81' None of the B. Monchengladbach players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.

80' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
77' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. St. Pauli will take a throw-in.
74' Philipp Treu swings the cross over. Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
74' Eric Smith (St. Pauli) attempts to chip the defensive wall, but they make the block.

72' The corner kick is deflected to Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.
72' Now B. Monchengladbach have a corner.

71' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.

70' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Robin Braun stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick is awarded to St. Pauli.
68' Alexander Blessin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Erik Ahlstrand (St. Pauli) replacing Johannes Eggestein.

67' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
66' Substitution. Lukas Ullrich will be replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
66' It is time for a substitution. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is on for Robin Hack.
66' The substitution has been made. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Alassane Plea.
66' The shots on goal statistics – 4:0.
64' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
62' Poor challenge! Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) is penalised for tripping and Robin Braun blows his whistle. B. Monchengladbach are awarded the free kick.
61' This shall not pass! Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
58' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by St. Pauli, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) has tested the patience of referee Robin Braun and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. St. Pauli win a free kick.
52' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends a chip pass into the box, but Nikola Vasilj is quickest to intercept the ball.
49' PENALTY APPEAL by St. Pauli, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

48' Nikola Vasilj doesn't have to worry about this one. Alassane Plea plays a pass into the feet of Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.

47' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. B. Monchengladbach are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and B. Monchengladbach players have a reason to celebrate!
44' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Robin Braun makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
44' 2 - 0 GOAL - 2:0! Robin Hack found Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box, he spotted goalkeeper Nikola Vasilj off his line and chipped the ball into the net. What a cheeky lob!
43' Philipp Treu (St. Pauli) attempts to find Johannes Eggestein, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
42' B. Monchengladbach are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
40' A cross from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

37' Jackson Irvine sets up Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) for a shot from distance, but the effort is badly misjudged and it flies yards past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
34' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robin Braun blows for a foul. B. Monchengladbach have a free kick.
31' St. Pauli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

31' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. St. Pauli force a corner. They send men into the box.
30' Oladapo Afolayan (St. Pauli) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
30' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
29' Jackson Irvine (St. Pauli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
28' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
26' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.
24' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Nikola Vasilj has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
22' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) shoots from inside the box after his amazing individual effort. He beats the goalkeeper, but hits one of the defending players and it bounces away.
21' It looks like Joe Scally may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Gerardo Seoane replaces him with Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
20' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
19' Moritz Nicolas steps in and intercepts a long pass from Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli).

16' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
13' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) was set free in the area by Marvin Friedrich and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:0.
13' The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) will take the corner.

11' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St. Pauli.
11' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.
10' The free kick from long range, taken by B. Monchengladbach, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The referee points to the corner flag and B. Monchengladbach will take a corner.
10' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. B. Monchengladbach earn a free kick.
8' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and St. Pauli will have a goal kick.

7' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball has crossed the sideline. B. Monchengladbach are taking a throw-in.
6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a long ball in, but Nikola Vasilj comfortably gathers the ball.

4' Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
2' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Nikola Vasilj comes off the line to clear the ball away.
1' The first half has just begun.
St. Pauli will kick-off.
Robin Braun was nominated as the referee for this game.
